speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: MOF supports Singapore's growth towards a value-creating economy, a thriving city and an inclusive society anchored on shared values.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We aim to sustain this through sound public finance policies and management and an effective and efficient Government that seeks to innovate and deliver value for money.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: This is because we have always emphasised prudent spending and built reliable, broad-based revenue sources.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We have also invested our reserves prudently and spent the investment returns in sustainable ways.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: In this environment, we must continue to focus on spending within our means.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: Even as expenditures on transport infrastructure, healthcare and housing increase, we must emphasise value-for-money in every programme and maintain the approach of targeting subsidies towards those most in need.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: In a future with tighter constraints in land and manpower, we must strive to be more productive and innovative to deliver better outcomes.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We must do so in a way that keeps the economy vibrant and the tax system progressive.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: To transform from a value-adding into a value-creating economy, our firms must shift from competing on cost or adding incremental value, to creating new, innovative and differentiated products and services.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: MOF will support the development of a conducive environment for businesses to restructure, innovate and internationalise.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: In this next phase of development, our focus will be on partnering firms to acquire deep capabilities to innovate and succeed in overseas markets.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will align Government support with these goals to ensure that innovative, growth-oriented businesses can access this support more easily and effectively.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: Where appropriate, we will form partnerships with Trade Associations and Chambers, develop new industry platforms, like the National Trade Infrastructure, and capitalise on private sector financing and expertise to help firms to grow and transform through better use of technology and new business models.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: To make it easier to do business in Singapore, we will review existing regulations to reduce compliance burden and costs, particularly for small companies, as well as further leverage infocomm technology to deliver improved services to businesses.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: On the international front, we will continue to advance Singapore's economic interests through active participation in major regional and global financial fora, such as ASEAN, APEC and G20.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will also partner actively with international organisations like the IMF and World Bank to ensure international financial stability and sustainable economic development.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: In addition, we will maintain our competitiveness in attracting and retaining substantive business activities here.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: For our firms to create value, we need people with deep skills and passion for their work and the capacity to innovate.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: Through SkillsFuture, we will invest in our people to maximise their potential.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will collaborate with unions, employers and training providers to develop a high quality, integrated system of education and training that responds to the evolving needs of our Page: 31 businesses and the economy.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: These are critical partnerships to chart out the future skills and jobs of the economy.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We must provide opportunities for all Singaporeans to do well and realise their potential throughout life.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will invest more to provide every child with access to quality pre-school to ensure a good start in life.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: In the schooling years, we will continue to build multiple pathways to success.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We are also doing more to help our seniors stay healthy, lead active lives and contribute their skills and expertise.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: Many of our seniors will be our baby boomers, who are now in their 50s and 60s and they will be at the forefront of successful ageing.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We will continue to build on our healthcare and retirement adequacy systems.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We have introduced the Pioneer Generation Package, implemented MediShield Life and raised healthcare subsidies for lower- to middle-income Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: There will be more opportunities for seniors to learn, volunteer and take part in activities within their neighbourhoods.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: We have also made significant changes to our CPF system to help CPF members accumulate more CPF savings, for example, by providing additional extra interest on lower balances of older members.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: Singaporeans will also be given more choices and flexibility in their retirement planning through the CPF system.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: A cohesive and inclusive society is anchored on personal responsibility, strong families and communities.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: For families, we will enhance care support to help Singaporeans balance their aspirations in work and family life.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: For stronger communities, we will support Singaporeans to volunteer and contribute to causes meaningful to them, through improved matching with volunteer opportunities and providing volunteer training.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: In addition, we will ensure affordable access to community infrastructure to be inclusive, to promote social mixing and to strengthen social cohesion.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: The public sector will itself need to transform to be ready for the future and digital technologies will be an important means to do so.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: For Singaporeans who may be less familiar with technology, we will continue to provide digital assistance and access so that every Singaporean can benefit.

speaker: The Minister for Finance (Mr Heng Swee Keat)
text: Within Government, we will also leverage technology to drive efficiencies and use data analytics to improve operations and support policy-making.
